title: AERONEX Experiment 01: RTAB-Map LiDAR+RGB-D run 1 reconstructed map
nature: Static visualisation of an exported SLAM point cloud. Not a live simulation.

downsampling.method: voxel-grid centroid (one point per occupied voxel, mean of the original points); normal = normalised mean of sign-aligned normals
downsampling.point_order: random permutation (seed 7); any prefix is a uniform subsample

encoding.layout: N x int16[3] positions, then N x int8[3] normals (little endian)

alignment_used_for_gt.from: benchmark eval.json, trajectories.final.alignment (Umeyama SE(3), no scale)

trajectory_display_resampling: odometry and ground truth thinned to poses >= 0.10 m apart; optimised keyframes all kept
